This is a teaching repo for an R data science course. The audience is master
students in economics who are new to R.

Prefer:

- base R and readable names over clever one-liners
- clear names over comments
- small, focused edits over refactors
- one idea per change

Do not add packages unless the script already imports them.
When a script has a bug, explain the cause before proposing a fix.
Never invent functions or arguments — if unsure, say so.
